resources.string: Android can stop alarms from ringing or showing. Allow these, and your alarms will ring on time, even with the phone locked. Each one takes a tap.
Needed to show the alarm screen and the Snooze and Dismiss buttons.
Lets the alarm fill the screen, also when the phone is locked.
Without it, alarms can ring minutes late.
Alarms can\'t start if Android restricts Alarmist in the background (App info › Battery).
Recommended. Keeps Android from delaying or stopping Alarmist to save battery.
Optional. Brings the wake-up check to the front while you use the phone, and lets anti-cheat bring the alarm screen back if you leave it.

Alarms can\'t ring while the phone is switched off. Android doesn\'t let apps switch the phone on; only some phone makers\' own clock apps can. Leave the phone on overnight (airplane mode is fine). If an alarm was missed because the phone was off, Alarmist tells you when it starts again.

Samsung: open Settings › Battery (and device care) › Background usage limits. Make sure Alarmist isn\'t in Sleeping or Deep sleeping apps, and add it to Never sleeping apps. In App info › Battery, choose Unrestricted.
Xiaomi: in App info, turn on Autostart and set Battery saver to No restrictions. Lock Alarmist in the recent apps screen (pull it down) so cleaning doesn\'t close it.
Huawei/Honor: open Settings › Battery › App launch, turn off Manage automatically for Alarmist and allow all three options (auto-launch, secondary launch, run in background).
OnePlus: in App info › Battery usage, allow background activity and turn off battery optimisation. Lock Alarmist in the recent apps screen.
Oppo/Realme: in App info › Battery usage, allow background activity and auto launch, and turn off Optimise battery use. Lock Alarmist in the recent apps screen.
Vivo: open Settings › Battery › Background power consumption management and allow Alarmist. Turn on Autostart in i Manager.
Some phones close apps in the background to save battery, which can stop alarms. If an alarm is missed, look up your phone\'s settings below.
